explanation: Let dp[v] count ordered sequences totaling v. Try every candidate as its final value and add dp[v-candidate]. Arbitrary-precision cells preserve intermediate counts before producing the promised int-sized final result.
timeComplexity: O(target times c) arithmetic operations for c candidates; big-integer costs depend on count width.
spaceComplexity: O(target) arbitrary-precision integer cells, plus their count bit storage.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
